steps.say: Rupiah notes and coins have different values.

figure.alt: One Rp10.000 note, one Rp5.000 note and two Rp2.000 notes.

steps.say: Start with the note worth the most, then add the rest.
Change is the money you get back. Take the price away from the money you pay.
You can also count up from the price to the money paid.

check.prompt: A pencil costs Rp3.500 and an eraser costs Rp2.000. How much do they cost altogether?
hints: Add the thousands first, then the hundreds.

check.prompt: Dewi buys a drink for Rp7.000 and pays with Rp10.000. How much change does Dewi get?
hints: Change is the money paid take away the price.
Count up from Rp7.000 to Rp10.000.
Count in thousands: Rp8.000, Rp9.000, and so on.
